## Goal

A beautiful baseline any agent gets for free and any agent can override completely: two bases, one token system, forms and questionnaires on fields, and guidance against churned APIs.

## Owned requirements

Close each with the check below, through the real public interface (README §3).

| ID | Requirement | Route | Concrete check |
|---|---|---|---|
| KT-03 | Design-system packs ship for Base UI and Radix bases; one base per artifact; the default chosen by evaluation (EVAL-01) | B, E | Both base packs type-check and render every component; default base set from EVAL-01 evidence |
| KT-04 | One token system themes every kit library, supports dark mode and accepts host brand themes; names align with MCP Apps host variables | B, R | Token change restyles every kit visual (screenshot diff); dark mode; host brand theme; MCP Apps variable mapping test; Mirza reviews |
| KT-05 | Questionnaire and form components (choices with recommended option, ranking, scales, text, per-item comments, required items, sections, progress) persist through drafts | B, R | Questionnaire features each persist through fields and appear labelled in results; Mirza reviews |
| KT-08 | "Write this, not that" guidance and lint autofixes for every kit library and recently changed tool (Base UI `render`, Tailwind 4, Zod 4, `motion/react`, `@xyflow/react`, Mermaid 12, TanStack Table 9, the `cn` package), including the wrong-base diagnostic | M | Each guidance rule has a lint fixture with a working autofix; wrong-base TS2322 shape becomes MOSTRA_KIT_WRONG_BASE |
| KT-10 | Design freedom: nothing enforces kit usage; every kit visual reads the tokens, accepts `className` and can be copied and edited; the defaults give a beautiful result without design skill | B, R | Restyle tests: className and copied components override kit visuals; an artifact with no kit usage verifies cleanly |

## Scope

From [WORK_PACKAGES.md](../WORK_PACKAGES.md):

- per-base registry packs (Base UI, Radix), type-checked in CI;
- resolution without copying, and `mostra add` copying;
- the default base, Base UI (D72);
- one OKLCH token system with dark mode and host brand themes, mapped to the MCP Apps variables;
- the questionnaire and form components on fields;
- the "write this, not that" guidance and lint autofixes, including the wrong-base diagnostic.

Design detail for this package:

- Per-base registry packs (Base UI default, Radix), resolution without copying, `mostra add` copying.
- OKLCH tokens with dark mode, host brand themes and MCP Apps variable mapping.
- Questionnaire and form components on `useField`.
- Churn guidance and lint autofixes, including `MOSTRA_KIT_WRONG_BASE` from the TS2322 shape seen in EVAL-01 controls.
- Check EVAL-01b's result before setting the default (D75).

## Out of scope

- Data and visualization wrappers (WP-19)

## Acceptance evidence

- every component in both bases type-checks and renders;
- the cross-base idiom produces `MOSTRA_KIT_WRONG_BASE` with a working fix;
- token changes restyle every kit visual (screenshot diff);
- questionnaire answers persist and appear labelled in results;
- Mirza reviews representative screens.

Also: `pnpm check` green, diff reviewed, the progress report's evidence table complete for every owned requirement (README §3), the evidence matrix regenerated, docs and AGENTS.md current, and the report finalized after acceptance (README §4).

## Risks and notes

- The Base UI template's `scroll-area.tsx` failed `tsc` out of the box (VERIFIED_FACTS): run the packs through Mostra's strict type-check in CI.

## Handoff

Kit visuals for every later kit package to build on.
